verdict.rationale: Keycloak's docs say users can set up two-factor authentication from the account console, and the admin guide covers 'WebAuthn together with Two-Factor' in browser flows. That shows MFA exists, but the evidence never names TOTP authenticator apps, backup or recovery codes, or step-up enforcement. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP/OTP authenticator documentation, backup/recovery codes, step-up authentication enforcement (e.g., per-client or per-level-of-assurance flows), admin-enforced MFA policy, and independent corroboration.
